label: Figure 4.5: A rectangular hyperbola where PED = 1 at every point
alt: A convex rectangular hyperbola demand curve for taxi rides with shaded revenue rectangles a, b and c, where price times quantity is 600 everywhere.
caption: A demand curve for taxi rides with P × Q = 600 at every point. Moving from $30 and 20 (thousand) rides to $12 and 50 (thousand) rides, the revenue lost (area a, $360 thousand) exactly equals the revenue gained (area c, $360 thousand). Total revenue never changes along the curve, so PED = 1 at every point.
